description: This file is a shell script used for testing notes trees in a Git repository. It contains test setup, verification, and manipulation commands related to notes and non-notes within Git commits, employing git commands and shell scripting constructs.

methods.name: start_note_commit
methods.description: Sets up a commit with notes in the Git repository.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies that the notes associated with commits match expected notes.
